  "memo":"Only R03 holds: the US-issued card was used from a Russian IP and AVS failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The remaining rule conditions do not hold. Travel with a newly used device and an address away from home is a plausible benign explanation, not independent adverse evidence. No installment was due, so non-payment cannot support a finding. Recommend needs_check under §6.6(b), implemented as a hold for issuer authentication and account identity verification. No check has run; id_check is the required and most decision-changing next check. Contact is not required. Decline and escalation are not permitted on the current evidence."
